instruction: Hide the tab bar in GIMP.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully hid GIMP docks by navigating Windows menu and clicking Hide Docks in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus (Windows menu), toggle UI visibility settings, understands dock/tab/window concepts.
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed the agent can toggle GIMP UI settings via Windows menu. This variation targets a different but related setting (tab bar visibility) using the same menu.
metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding the tab bar in GIMP via Windows > Show Tabs (uncheck). Evaluator checks sessionrc for show-tabs=no after quitting GIMP to save config.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches GIMP sessionrc file which stores UI session state including tab visibility settings.
Metric check_config_status correctly parses GIMP's S-expression config format by stripping parentheses and splitting tokens, then matching key-value pairs.
Expected values (key='show-tabs', value='no') are semantically correct for verifying tab bar hidden state.
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP with Ctrl+Q to force session state to be saved to sessionrc before reading it.
Minor issue: rules dict has typo 'type:' (extra colon) instead of 'type', but this does not affect functionality since check_config_status only accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'].

Minor concern: check_config_status returns 1.0 on the FIRST matching 'show-tabs no' entry. GIMP sessionrc can have multiple dock sections each with their own show-tabs setting, so the evaluator could pass if only one dock has tabs hidden while others still show tabs.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix typo in rules: change 'type:' to 'type' for cleanliness.
Consider whether the evaluator should verify that ALL docks have show-tabs=no, not just the first matching entry, to ensure complete tab hiding across all GIMP docks.
